subtitles: One fungal spore, observed at the beginning of a larger biological story.
Controlled conditions introduce the culture to a real Petri dish.
The same culture initiates hyphal growth and forms a branching network.
A selected colony lineage is transferred to a new sterile culture.
Small cultures progress to larger controlled growth vessels.
A transparent incubator makes environmental conditions and growth observable.
A fixed incubation container reveals the fine architecture of mycelium.
Colonized substrate develops primordia and mushroom fruiting bodies.
Selected upstream mycelial culture feeds a separate fermentation pathway.
Observations, process models and feedback connect biology with engineering.
